title: Predictive Maintenance on Azure for Manufacturers: What You Actually Need Before the Model
description:
Predictive maintenance only pays off when a warning arrives early enough to act on. In this episode of the iFAKT series, we start with the maintenance decision and work back to the evidence and data needed before choosing a model.
You will learn how to define the decision first and connect Azure data to the maintenance process.
Who it is for: Maintenance managers, reliability engineers and plant IT.
